title: Huss Valley Game
description: Free multiplayer Halloween chase game in the browser: pumpkin-headed trick-or-treaters race across a field to the finish while up to 4 ghosts hunt them. Up to 30 players per room, WebGL, no download, no account.
how_to_play: Press Play to join a live room. Trick-or-treaters: run from START to FINISH with WASD/arrow keys (or the on-screen joystick on phones), grabbing candy for points and a speed boost. Ghosts: leave the haunted house and catch runners with a swipe attack. Gamepads are supported.
